description: The municipality of Messina publishes the locations of public-lighting poles within its territory. Resource descriptions identify 2019 Shapefile, CSV and GeoJSON inventories, plus a CSV updated to 30 June 2022 with column headings that differ from the earlier files. The Shapefile description explicitly states WGS84 coordinates, EPSG:4326; that statement is not assumed to cover every resource. Pole locations can define the asset footprint for lighting-service capacity planning. Lamp power, electricity demand, circuit connectivity, installation condition and positional accuracy are not stated in the inspected metadata. The description specifies CC BY 4.0 and an OpenStreetMap-specific attribution and redistribution addendum, which must be read for that reuse. Cost and download conditions remain unverified. The public metadata API returned the exact identifier and title, while the web landing page returned no readable metadata. No files were downloaded. Bari’s lighting inventory covers a different municipality and includes other component attributes. No directly related record was established.
